data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 was $145.3m. The syndicate reports mixed prior year development: there was adverse development relating to natural catastrophe events (the report explicitly cites Hurricanes Ida, Laura and Storm Uri) which impacted the property reinsurance book, while other movements across years are not clearly quantified in gross terms in the notes. The available claims development table is presented gross but does not provide a single explicit gross prior-year movement figure; therefore a quantified gross prior-year movement cannot be determined from the disclosed tables and notes.
raw_causal_phrases: experienced adverse claims activity attributable to a number of natural catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Ida, Laura and Storm Uri.
The claims ratio of syndicate 6107 has deteriorated to 53% in 2022 (2021: 47%) mostly due to increased claims on the property reinsurance book.
The total estimate as at 31 December 2022 included within claims outstanding is $103.7m (2021: $113.3m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding, prior-year column). No explicit gross 'movement in prior years' (PYD) figure was found in the notes; the report provides a gross claims development table that is presentationally non-standard and does not yield a single clear gross PYD sum without reconstructing prior diagonals (triangle rows are given as development percentages and summary rows rather than a standard cumulative triangle). Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Gross premium mix percentages provided in text relate to gross premiums earned; amounts were derived by applying those percentages to gross premiums written. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD).
